ingredients.name: hearthmint
ingredients.blurb: A low creeping mint every herb bed grows. Steeped, it knits small wounds.

ingredients.name: bramblewort
ingredients.blurb: Thorny and bitter; carters chew it to stay awake on the road.

ingredients.name: emberroot
ingredients.blurb: A red tuber that is warm to the hand even in frost.

ingredients.name: frostcap
ingredients.blurb: A pale mushroom raised in the shade of the herb sheds.

ingredients.name: palewick
ingredients.blurb: A white bloom that opens only at dawn and smells of clean linen.

ingredients.name: duskbell
ingredients.blurb: Its purple cups close at noon. Midwives use a pinch for sleep, and no more.

ingredients.name: beast gall
ingredients.blurb: Cut from the great beasts of the wilds: rank, and full of their fury.

ingredients.name: grave dust
ingredients.blurb: Swept from the bones of the restless dead. It is always cold.

ingredients.name: brimstone ash
ingredients.blurb: What is left when a thing from outside the world is cut down. It smoulders for a week.

ingredients.name: glimmer dust
ingredients.blurb: Shaken from the wings and hair of the bright folk. It never quite settles.

ingredients.name: drake scale
ingredients.blurb: A scale the size of a hand, still hot at the root.

ingredients.name: slag salt
ingredients.blurb: The crust left by things that were never alive the way people are.

ingredients.name: giant's marrow
ingredients.blurb: A crock of it feeds a family through winter; a spoonful in a draught makes a porter of a clerk.

recipes.name: Draught of Mending
recipes.blurb: Heroes setting out carry one more healing draught than they bought.

recipes.name: Draught of Second Wind
recipes.blurb: A stronger mending brew: four healing draughts a batch for heroes setting out.

recipes.name: Fever-Breaker
recipes.blurb: Pulls a townsperson back when a plague-bringer's night visit would take them.

recipes.name: Gravelight Tonic
recipes.blurb: Heroes bound for a haunt of the restless dead are harder to hit there.

recipes.name: Huntsman's Musk
recipes.blurb: Smells like the pack to the pack. Heroes bound for a beasts' lair are harder to hit there.

recipes.name: Ironhide Brew
recipes.blurb: Skin like cold leather for a day. Heroes bound for a warband's camp or a rival company are harder to hit there.

recipes.name: Clearsight Elixir
recipes.blurb: Glamours slide off the eye. Heroes bound for a schemer's den are harder to hit there.

recipes.name: Cinderproof Salve
recipes.blurb: Rubbed on before the fire comes. Heroes bound for a dragon's lair are harder to hit there.

recipes.name: Liquid Ember
recipes.blurb: No use to heroes, but smiths and glassblowers far away pay well for it.
